Lina (docs): quick catch on PR #9734: embeds doc shows `Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8` but cURL example uses no header and Python snippet sets `content-type` lowercase. Should standardize.
Omar (eng-api): server tolerates case and charset, but our proxy strips charset in logs. Recommend docs show `Content-Type: application/json` (capital C/T) to match examples in other endpoints.
Jules (sdk): SDK auto-sets headers but our README copy has `content-type` lowercase in the JS fetch example. I'll update generator to emit `Content-Type`.
Lina (docs): also the response example has `usage: { tokens: 5 }` but runtime emits `usage: { input_tokens: 3, output_tokens: 2 }` now. That mismatch is confusing in quickstarts.
Omar (eng-api): yep runtime changed after rollout. Docs should show the full shape and add a one-line migration note: old `tokens` -> new fields.
QA-bot: flagged 2 downstream tests: docs examples vs integration tests.
Lina (docs): plan: 1) unify header casing to `Content-Type: application/json`; 2) replace response sample with updated `usage` object; 3) add short migration bullet; 4) add tiny note about proxy stripping `charset` so users shouldn't rely on it.
Jules (sdk): will bump snippet generator and run unit tests.
Omar (eng-api): adding a comment with internal link to header-normalization doc.
Lina (docs): pushing patch to #9734 now. Thanks :sparkles:
QA-bot: PR #9734 updated by Lina (docs): headers and usage sample fixed.
